item.title: CSS Women’s Hockey Falls in OT Against #11 Hamline
item.description: DULUTH, Minn.- The St. Scholastica women’s hockey team hosted #11 ranked Hamline on Friday night. After ending regulation tied 2-2, the Pipers found the back of the net to take down the Saints 3-2. CSS is back in action on Saturday, December 6th, against Hamline. Game time is at 4 p.m. Categories: College, Friday Night Frenzy, Sports

item.title: Duluth Denfeld Boys Basketball Picks Up First Win in Home Opener Against North Branch
item.description: DULUTH, Minn.- The Duluth Denfeld boys basketball team held their home opener against North Branch on Friday night. The Hunters defend their home court defeating the Vikings 78-66. Denfeld’s next game is on Thursday, December 11th, against Cloquet. Tip-off is at 7 p.m. Categories: Friday Night Frenzy, High School, Sports

item.title: UWS Men’s Basketball Can’t Complete Comeback Against St. Norbert
item.description: SUPERIOR, Wis.- The UWS men’s basketball team aimed for its second consecutive win on Saturday, taking on St. Norbert. The Yellowjackets fall to the Green Knights 64-56, dropping to 1-7 on the year. UWS will return to action on Wednesday, December 10th, against St. Scholastica. Game time is at 7 p.m. Categories: College, Sports

item.title: #12 UW-Eau Claire Tops UWS Women’s Hockey 4-2 in WIAC Battle
item.description: SUPERIOR, Wis.- The UWS women’s hockey team hosted 12th-ranked Eau Claire on Saturday. After ending the first period tied 2-2, the Blugolds scored two goals to take down the Yellowjackets 4-2. UWS is back in action on Friday, December 12th, against Concordia (Minn.) Puck drop is at 7 p.m. Categories: College, Sports
